Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the time yesterday — great conversation and I appreciated the level of detail on your team’s extraction and indexing workflows. Per our discussion, I sketched a concise trial (bridge) plan so you can validate latency, relevance, and cost for the two main flows you showed: 1) search-augmented summarization for analyst reports, and 2) conversational Q&A over archived meeting notes.

Attached: brightwave-proposed-trial.pdf (outline + timeline)

High-level proposed trial (2 weeks)
- Objectives: verify 95th-percentile latency < 300ms for typical queries; match existing relevance baseline on our prompt set (we’ll run A/B on 500 sample queries); validate end-to-end cost at target $0.003 / 1k tokens.
- Success criteria (please confirm):
  • Latency: p95 < 300ms
  • Quality: precision@5 >= baseline (we will share prompt set)
  • Operational: KV cache hits > 40% on repeated sessions
- Scope: two model endpoints (redwood-candidate-1 quantized and redwood-standard-2), hosted in us-west-2; sample dataset = 5000 docs (your anonymized subset).
- Timeline: prep (3 business days), run (10 business days), analysis (2 business days) — kickoff target next week if you approve.
- Responsibilities:
  • BrightWave: provide anonymized sample (S3 link) + procurement contact for purchase order.
  • Redwood: deploy trial endpoints, provide test harness and success-metrics dashboard, weekly check-ins with CS.

Next steps requested from you:
1) Confirm success criteria above or add/adjust.
2) Share procurement contact for trial order/quote (we can issue a short-term evaluation agreement).
3) Provide an S3 read-only link to the sample dataset (we will not persist beyond the trial period).

If you’re aligned I’ll pull in Ben (AE) for pricing and Monica (CS) to schedule onboarding.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
